GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-05-05T18:56:46Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Configuring Reminders with the silo process
Description: We have implemented our silohost in a windows service. We have a number of grains, which should run "batch-like". Some with 2-hour interval, some with 24-hour interval and some with monthly interval. We thought a good implementation of that would be as reminders.

We need a place to configure these reminders in Orleans, and we thought a natural place for that is when starting the windows, service which holds the silo. Something like the below.

However, Orleans will not let use GrainClient to get a reference to a grain. And as I understand we need a grain to register a reminder. We get an error "You are running inside the provider code, on the silo. GrainClient.GrainFactory should only be used on the client side. Inside the provider code use GrainFactory that is passed via IProviderRuntime (use providerRuntime.GrainFactory)."

Is there any way to register a grain when starting the silo host process?

```
        _siloHost = new SiloHost("MySilo", ClusterConfiguration.LocalhostPrimarySilo());
        _siloHost.InitializeOrleansSilo();
        _siloHost.StartOrleansSilo();

        GrainClient.GrainFactory.GetGrain<IMyBatchGrain>("MyBatchGrain").Register();
```
